title: Hydraulic Timescale and Retry-Translation Mechanism Characterization
question: Can the loss and recovery of the raw full-versus-two-half head-defect relationship across actual retry horizons be explained by hydraulic state and local hydraulic timescale descriptors strongly enough to justify a later, separately qualified estimator or refinement-semantic proposal?

frozen_matrix.same_endpoint_reference: reuse F-VQ28 resolved N512 classification only; do not replace unavailable rows post hoc

hydraulic_descriptors_gate_A.evaluate_at: uniform committed T0 state before the prescribed bottom-head perturbation
hydraulic_descriptors_gate_A.reason: Richards hydraulic diffusivity has scale K/C. With a bottom-head perturbation, C*L^2/K is a physically interpretable local diffusion timescale. This is a diagnostic candidate, not an admitted normalizer.
hydraulic_descriptors_gate_A.predeclared_falsifier: If the same initial state shows non-monotone conservative/under-conservative classifications while lambda_attempt changes monotonically with retry halving, an initial-state scalar hydraulic-timescale threshold is insufficient by construction.

conditional_gate_B.purpose: Characterize dynamic local K, C, K/C and timescale changes along the existing full and two-half trial branches at the actual retry horizons.
conditional_gate_B.restriction: Do not fit an acceptance threshold or optimize a normalizer. Freeze dynamic observation locations before execution and retain exact checkpoint/trial semantics.

next_action: Implement Gate A as a test-only hydraulic-descriptor extractor and deterministic classifier against the already frozen F-VQ28 Gate B C/U/X patterns. Persist evidence before any conditional dynamic-local Gate B is designed.
